cash_m.note: Company cash and cash equivalents; excludes cash held by Consolidated Funds (inside assets of Consolidated Funds). Includes cash of consolidated VIEs such as SPW, which may only settle those entities' obligations.

diluted_shares_m.source: STEP Q2 FY2027 earnings release, 8-K EX-99.1 (sources/ex99-1-q2fy27.htm.gz), adjusted weighted-average shares for Q2 FY2027 (Class A plus RSUs plus exchange of Class B, C and D units)
diluted_shares_m.note: The per-share basis for ANI. The XBRL diluted count (82.3M) is Class A only and understates the economic share count.

ttm_fcf_m.source: SEC XBRL operating_cash_flow - capex (ttm ytd), filed 2026-11-09

notes: GAAP ttm_* figures are distorted by Consolidated Funds (operating cash flow includes fund investment purchases) and by mark-to-market expense on the SPW profits interest ($372.1M in Q2 FY2027); the call values STEP on adjusted net income (ANI).

TTM (Q3 FY2026-Q2 FY2027, quarters to 2025-12-31 through 2026-09-30): fee revenues $1,069.96M; FRE $426.39M (39.9% margin); pre-tax ANI $378.63M; ANI $292.56M; ANI per share $2.36 (0.65 + 0.57 + 0.48 + 0.66); blended tax rate on pre-tax ANI 22.6% in Q2.

TTM FRE attributable to the SPW profits interest $87.39M and to other non-controlling interests $74.20M; TTM PRE $197.15M gross, $104.55M net of non-controlling interests ($83.2M of the Q3 FY2026 SPW incentive fee went to the profits interest).
Q2 FY2027: fee revenues $297.6M (+37% YoY, incl. $4.2M retroactive fees); FRE $126.2M (42% margin); ANI $82.9M, $0.66 per adjusted share; gross realized performance fees $65.1M; PRE $32.3M.

September 30, 2026: AUM $261.0B (+25%), FEAUM $158.2B (+19%), undeployed fee-earning capital $42.4B (+42%), accrued carried interest allocations $2,383.4M, accrued carried interest-related compensation $1,356.0M (net about $1,027M).

SPW option agreement (10-Q): StepStone expects to exercise its call on the SPW profits interest when first exercisable after June 30, 2027; estimated fair value $2,885.3M, undiscounted $3,588.3M; expected settlement 25% cash ($897.2M) and 75% Partnership units; redemption price = SPW adjusted net income x adjusted trading multiple of STEP (14.2x at September 30, 2026; 25% discount rate). No FY2027 supplemental dividend; the cash is retained toward the payment.
Dividend: quarterly $0.33 declared November 5, 2026 (raised from $0.28 in August 2026); FY2026 supplemental $0.55 paid June 2026; no FY2027 supplemental.
